title: Create World KB setup guide and dedicated instance deployment
description:
## Problem
The agent currently relies on a possibly-shared MemorySmith wiki instance for item/blueprint/knowledge lookups. There is no documented procedure for setting up a dedicated World KB instance, which is required for:
- Isolated testing without polluting shared data
- Deterministic blueprint/item resolution
- Production deployment with dedicated resources

## Scope
1. **Setup guide** (`Data/Pages/Guides/world-kb-setup.md`):
   - Prerequisites (MemorySmith API instance, database)
   - Configuration steps
   - Environment variables and appsettings.json entries
   - Verification steps (curl examples)

2. **Deployment script** (`Scripts/Deploy-WorldKb.ps1`):
   - Create/update the wiki instance
   - Seed initial item registry entries
   - Seed test blueprints
   - Verify connectivity

3. **Configuration reference:**
   - Document WorldKbUrl, ApiKey, and all related settings
   - Add startup health check that verifies World KB connectivity
   - Log meaningful error message if World KB is unreachable

## Files
- Data/Pages/Guides/world-kb-setup.md (new)
- Scripts/Deploy-WorldKb.ps1 (new)
- Agent.Memory/RestMemoryGateway.cs (add startup health check)

## Validation
- Guide can be followed end-to-end by new developer
- Deployed instance passes health check
- Agent successfully resolves items and blueprints from dedicated instance
